title: List NTLM clients that do not negotiate signing (events 4022/4023)
summary: Read-only PowerShell that reads the NTLM operational log on one or more servers and lists unique client/process combinations whose Negotiated Flags lack NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE_SIGN (0x10) — the clients that will be rejected when servers require NTLM signing.
notes: Read-only; changes nothing. Remote reads need the Event Log Readers right and remote event log access on each server.
Event level is not a filter: signed and unsigned connections both log as Warning.
An empty result on a server older than Windows Server 2019 means 'no data', not 'ready'.
Message field labels follow the English event text; adjust the regexes on localised systems.

source.label: Find clients that will fail NTLM signing enforcement
